typography.role: Corporate typeface (Thin, Light, Regular, SemiBold, Bold)
Office documents and e-mail when the corporate typeface is unavailable

logo_usage.clear_space: Surround the mark with as much free space as possible, away from other graphic elements
logo_usage.min_size: 3 mm height for the mark in all applications
logo_usage.background_rules: Preferred on white; then corporate colour backgrounds; dark blue monochrome on light grey; white negative on dark or non-corporate dark colours; black positive where quality cannot be guaranteed
logo_usage.misuse: Do not distort, recolour, rotate, apply 3D effects, change the order or proportion of logotype and symbol, tile the mark, place it on busy images or non-approved background colours, or use low-resolution files

notes: From the ENAIRE Guía de uso de la marca (PDF, not stored). Write ENAIRE always in capitals. The guideline lists the symbol as complementary to the logotype; fluid configuration needs Brand Department approval.
